data.message: Fisher18: I commit to 18 tons this month; I invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is500 or100—not guaranteed recovery or optimal long-run income. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each person: what exact catch do you intend, and is it conditional?
